mechanism_claims.claim_text: PepC directly disrupts membranes in susceptible Gram-negative bacteria but not capsulated K. pneumoniae under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: K. pneumoniae activity is blocked by capsule; do not generalize PepC as active against capsulated K. pneumoniae.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PepW retains strong capsule binding but loses alpha-helical structure in the presence of capsule.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:PepW Retains Binding and Loses Structure

supports: binding gel, densitometry, and CD profiles

mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding strength alone is not treated as sufficient for antimicrobial activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Native MS/UVPD with stachyose supports different polysaccharide-interaction patterns for PepC and PepW.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Stachyose is a model polysaccharide surrogate, so this supports interaction mapping rather than whole-capsule quantification.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PepW-associated capsule aggregation/removal is supported by pelleting, capsule quantification, Percoll gradient, India ink, and TEM evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PepW, with PepC/PepY/PepF/PepK comparators where reported

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:PepW Induces Capsule Condensation and Disruption

supports: capsule quantification, viability control, Percoll, and India ink supporting evidence

mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level image quantification beyond the text-indexed source is not fabricated; source text/figure locators are preserved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The final capsule-disruption model is an author-proposed synthesis: PepW binding and structure loss are associated with capsule aggregation/loss, enabling remaining peptide to reach the membrane.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Kept as inferred/model synthesis, not promoted to a separately quantified direct assay.

caution_findings.note: Direct assays support capsule binding, structural change, aggregation/disruption, and membrane effects; the full pathway model remains inferred from convergent evidence.
